- Initial public release of smyx-sick-poultry-behavior-detect-analysis.
- Detects early signs of sickness in poultry and pigs via video analysis (e.g., trouble standing, ruffled feathers, isolation, drowsiness, appetite loss) up to 2-3 days before visible symptoms.
- Supports input from images, videos, URLs, and produces structured reports including behavior types, risk levels, and links to reports.
- Enables group/individual animal abnormality tracking, risk assessment, and cloud-based historical report queries.
- Strict privacy: user identity handled internally; no diagnosis or treatment advice provided—results are for early warning and screening only.
